people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.
translations.bsb: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
translations.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
translations.asv: Thus speaketh Jehovah, the God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
